steps.ask: Which part of the margin formula stays the same when the sample size changes?

lines.text: Let $k = 1.96\sqrt{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}$. It does not change, so the margin of error is $\frac{k}{\sqrt{\hl{2}{n}}}$.
